topic.name: The Power and Root Rules for Limits

question.explanation:
Applying the quotient rule, we get \[ \lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 2} \dfrac{3x}{\sqrt[3]{2x^4-5}} =\dfrac{\lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 2} 3x}{\lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 2}\sqrt[3]{2x^4-5}} \] We calculate the limits of the numerator and denominator, separately.

For the numerator, we have

\[ \begin{align} \lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 2} 3x &= 3\lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 2} x\\[5pt] &= 3\cdot 2\\[5pt] &= 6 \, . \end{align} \]

Applying the root rule in the denominator, we have \[ \begin{align} \lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 2}\sqrt[3]{2x^4-5} &= \sqrt[3]{\lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 2}(2x^4-5)} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt[3]{2(2)^4-5)} \\[5pt] &= \sqrt[3]{27} \\[5pt] &= 3 \,. \end{align} \]

Consequently, \[ \begin{align} \lim_\limits{x\rightarrow 1} \dfrac{3x}{\sqrt[3]{2x^4-5}} &=\dfrac{6}{3} = 2 \,. \end{align} \]

example.title: Applying the Root Rule to Compute a Limit

question.text: If the figure above shows the graph of the function $f(x),$ then
question.explanation:
From the graph, we get that $\lim\limits_{x\rightarrow \,2} f(x)=3.$

From the product rule, we have \[ \lim_{x\rightarrow \,2} (x-1)^2\,(f(x)-2)^3 = \lim_{x\rightarrow \,2} (x-1)^2 \cdot \lim_{x\rightarrow \,2}(f(x)-2)^3. \] We calculate the limits of each factor, separately.

Applying the power rule, we have \[ \begin{align*} \lim_{x\rightarrow \,2}(x-1)^2 &= \left(\lim_{x\rightarrow \,2}(x-1)\right)^2 \\[3pt] &= (2-1)^2 \\[5pt] &= 1^2 \\[5pt] &= 1\,, \end{align*} \] and \[ \begin{align*} \lim_{x\rightarrow \,2}(f(x)-2)^3 &= \left(\lim_{x\rightarrow \,2}(f(x)-2)\right)^3 \\[3pt] &= (3-2)^3 \\[5pt] &= 1^3 \\[5pt] &= 1\,. \end{align*} \] Finally, we have \[ \begin{align*} \lim_{x\rightarrow \,2} (x-1)^2\,(f(x)-2)^3 &= (1)\cdot (1) \\[5pt] &= \bbox[4pt,border: 1px solid lightgray]{1}. \end{align*} \]

question.text: Find the exact value of the limit.
question.explanation:
Applying the sum and root rules, we get

\[ \begin{align} \displaystyle{\lim_{t \to -1} \left(\sqrt[7]{(2t+1)^7}-\sqrt[3]{(t^2+t+1)^6}\right)}&= \displaystyle{\lim_{t \to -1}\sqrt[7]{(2t+1)^7}}-\displaystyle{\lim_{t \to -1}\sqrt[3]{(t^2+t+1)^6}}\\[5pt] &= \sqrt[7]{\left(\displaystyle{\lim_{t \to -1}(2t+1)}\right)^7}-\sqrt[3]{\left(\displaystyle{\lim_{t \to -1}(t^2+t+1)}\right)^6}\\[5pt] &= \sqrt[7]{(2(-1)+1)^7}-\sqrt[3]{(((-1)^2+(-1)+1))^6}\\[5pt] &= \sqrt[7]{(-2+1)^7}-\sqrt[3]{((1-1+1))^6}\\[5pt] &= \sqrt[7]{(-1)^7}-\sqrt[3]{(1)^6}\\[5pt] &= \sqrt[7]{-1}-\sqrt[3]{1}\\[5pt] &=-1-1\\[5pt] &=\bbox[4pt,border: 1px solid lightgray]{-2}. \end{align} \]
